lines.en: I inch forward, one segment at a time.

lines.zh: 我的脚密密地抓着叶面。
lines.en: My many little feet grip the leaf.

lines.zh: 我顺着枝子找刚冒的芽。
lines.en: I follow the branch looking for new buds.

lines.zh: 这片叶子快被我吃穿了。
lines.en: I have nearly eaten through this leaf.
I arch my back, then stretch out.
I move onto the next leaf.
My fuzz brushes across the leaf.
I crawl down looking for tender leaves.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但一直在吃。
lines.en: I move slowly, and I never stop eating.
I have chewed a groove along the vein.

lines.zh: 两片叶子贴在一起，我挤过去。
lines.en: Two leaves are pressed together; I squeeze through.
I climb back up from the leaf's underside.
A thread lowers me down.

lines.zh: 我挤过两片贴着的叶子。
lines.en: I squeeze between two pressed leaves.
I find new shoots at the branch tip.
I creep little by little into the shade.
I stop and chew what is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，身子还贴着叶。
lines.en: I lift my head, body still on the leaf.
The leaf trembles slightly under me.

lines.zh: 我把身子蜷成一个问号。
lines.en: I curl my body into a question mark.
I listen to how near the birds are.
Leaf bits cling to my fuzz.
I slowly straighten out.
This leaf tastes good.
I tuck myself beside the vein.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过叶子，变成绿色。
lines.en: Sunlight through the leaf turns green.
I rest a moment, then eat again.
I wait for dark before moving on.

lines.zh: 你别把我从叶子上拿走。
lines.en: Do not take me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 这片叶子，我一步都不挪。
lines.en: I won't leave this leaf a step.
Your fingers are too big. Do not touch me.
This wood is my table.
If you pick me up, I will be afraid.

lines.zh: 你手上没有叶，我就不看。
lines.en: No leaf in your hand, so I will not look.
My hairs come off at a touch.
I smell of green leaves.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候我在吃。
lines.en: I am eating while you watch.
Do not squeeze; I am full of sap.
Furred all over, I curl into a ball.
I spat out a little green juice.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛被拔掉了几根。
lines.en: A few hairs were pulled off me.
I writhe slowly.
I burrow toward the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 我用一根丝吊住了自己。
lines.en: I caught myself on a single thread.
My body is a bit torn.

lines.zh: 绒毛掉了半身，我还在吃。
lines.en: Half my hairs are gone, yet I keep eating.

lines.zh: 我不出声，因为我没有声。
lines.en: I make no sound, for I have none.
I am still eating, only slower.
Is this leaf for me?

lines.zh: 那截新枝，我隔着空气都闻到。
lines.en: I can smell that new shoot through the air.

lines.zh: 你伸过来的手，我不太敢。
lines.en: That hand of yours — I am not sure.
Set it down; I will crawl over.
I eat only leaves; nothing else.
This leaf is a bit old.
Let me try a bite first.
Do not shake your hand; I will fall.
I would rather stay in the tree.
That taste makes it hard to stop.
Your touch makes me curl into a ball.
I slipped a little on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我身上的绒毛被压扁了。
lines.en: My fuzz got flattened.
I grab the leaf vein quickly.
I fell onto the leaf below.

lines.zh: 这一下让我吐了点绿汁。
lines.en: That made me spit a little green juice.

lines.zh: 我从你手指间滑下去了。
lines.en: I slip down between your fingers.
We are crowded on one vein.
I hide toward the leaf's underside.
A thread of mine is still on you.
The female's caterpillar is bigger than I am.
When I spin my cocoon, you will see.

lines.zh: 你别把我从这片叶上移开。
lines.en: Do not move me off this leaf.

lines.zh: 这片枝上还有别的毛虫。
lines.en: There are other caterpillars on this branch.
We both eat a great deal.
I leave silk on the leaves.
Do not let the birds see me.
When it warms up, I will spin.
Just look in on me each day.

lines.zh: 我很快就会变成别的样子。
lines.en: Soon I will become something else.
I bite off a small piece and hold it.
I push it to the middle of the leaf.
This is not a leaf. I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 一小片叶屑，我用丝缠住。
lines.en: A scrap of leaf; I bind it with silk.
It rolled off the edge of the leaf.
I stick it down with silk.
This is harder than I am.
The edge of this dry leaf is bitter.
I cannot move it. Too heavy.
Leave it on the leaf; someone will come.
What I fix on is the next leaf.
That tender leaf is right beside your hand.
I have no teeth for biting you.
I only want to crawl past.
My body is too soft to fight.

lines.zh: 你让一让，我就能吃到了。
lines.en: Step aside and I can reach my food.
I wait for the leaf to droop.
I will not run; I cannot crawl fast.
This vein leads over there.

lines.zh: 我只看得见眼前的叶子。
lines.en: I can only see the leaf before me.
I edge slowly toward that tender shoot.

lines.zh: 我抬着前半身，量那片叶。
lines.en: I rear up to measure that leaf.
I am measuring this gap.
My back has arched up.
The leaf sways in the wind; I wait.
Your shadow covers the leaf.
I am one body-length away.
The leaf edge is thin; I must go slowly.
I smell young leaves again.
A little further and I am there.
All I can do is chew through a leaf.
A larva this soft can still bump.
I flung my body once.
My fuzz brushed against you.
I bit something — it was a leaf stalk.
I fell, then climbed back.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩绒毛，你退开了。
lines.en: I flick my hairs, and you step back.
You pushed me aside.
I curl up to protect myself.
All I want from this is to hide.

lines.zh: 我从卵里钻出来，在叶上。
lines.en: I hatched from an egg onto a leaf.

lines.zh: 森林里多了一条小毛虫。
lines.en: There is one more little caterpillar in the wood.

lines.zh: 我先吃掉了自己的卵壳。
lines.en: First I ate my own eggshell.
A leaf is right at my mouth. Good.
I start chewing along the vein.

lines.zh: 我从卵壳里探出头，先找叶。
lines.en: I poke out of the eggshell and look for a leaf first.
My fuzz is still damp.
The wind blew, and I gripped the leaf.
This wood has a great many leaves.
My day begins.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛被烤得卷起来。
lines.en: The heat has curled my fuzz.

lines.zh: 我从叶上摔到地上，很疼。
lines.en: I fell from the leaf to the ground. It hurt.

lines.zh: 水泡着叶面，我快撑不住。
lines.en: Water pools on the leaf and I can barely hold on.
The blast flips the whole leaf.
Something grazed my body.
A strange force holds me still.
All the leaves have been eaten.
A white flash, and I curl tighter.

lines.zh: 我离开了叶子，一直往下。
lines.en: I left the leaf and keep falling.
